identity_checks.detail: Name "DANIELA NOGUEIRA" vs Pentacam "NOGUEIRA ROCHA, DANIELA": surname ROCHA omitted, no conflict, no birth date. Exactly the protocol 0.B example. Handwritten "DANIELA N." (abbreviated surname), no birth date. Refraction is decisive input -> protocol blocks consolidation pending human confirmation. Exam 2026-09-22, 1 day after Pentacam.
Name "DANIELA NOGUEIRA" (ROCHA omitted); age 25 consistent with DOB 2001-01-28. Out-of-protocol device, never decisive -> non-blocking. Filename carries no patient name.
